::: {.videos}
5MinuteAI explains [hypothesis testing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Plya_ZXkOvs) in five minutes,
following the University of Washington's CSE 312 [@fiveminuteai_probstat].
:::

::: {.reading}
- @hoggtanis2015 [Sec. 8.1, pp. 361--368] covers tests about one mean.
- @hoggtanis2015 [Sec. 8.6, pp. 403--409] covers power of a statistical test.
- @CaseBerg01 [Sec. 8.3, pp. 382--401] covers methods of evaluating tests.
- @rice2007mathematical [Sec. 9.2, pp. 331--336] covers the Neyman--Pearson paradigm.
:::
